source_note: PLACEHOLDER rule values - invented, not verified pedagogy. See docs/TO_VERIFY.md

rationale.exam_urgent: PLACEHOLDER: demand for subjects with an exam soon comes first
rationale.expiring_followup: PLACEHOLDER: follow-ups whose window is closing come next
rationale.deficit: PLACEHOLDER: then rank by how far behind the student is

rationale.preferred_period: PLACEHOLDER: match the student's preferred time of day
rationale.spread_across_days: PLACEHOLDER: fill the emptiest days first
rationale.hard_subject_spacing: PLACEHOLDER: avoid stacking the same subject back-to-back
rationale.lesson_proximity: PLACEHOLDER: put a lesson's follow-up near the lesson
rationale.length_fit: PLACEHOLDER: prefer full-length sessions over scraps
rationale.topic_recency: PLACEHOLDER: prefer topics a recent lesson covered
